name: sx1262-frontend-915
summary: LoRa/(G)FSK radio for 902-928 MHz at up to +22 dBm: an SX1262 with Semtech's 915 MHz reference front end (PA feed, L/C match and harmonic filter, RX balun, a PE4259 SPDT RF switch driven by DIO2, antenna-side filter) ending in one 50 ohm antenna port. SPI slave plus BUSY, DIO1 IRQ and reset; 32 MHz crystal with internal load trim. Values from Semtech's reference BOM, which a person must confirm before fab

cite.reading: node:ant is the 50 ohm antenna side of the harmonics/RX filter (C9, L5, C10), where the e499v01b schematic p.1 marks 'Antenna matching' as not included
